C31.name: Diploma in AI & Data Engineering
C31.description: Focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data analytics, and intelligent cloud systems.

C33.name: Diploma in Aeronautical & Aerospace Technology
C33.description: Covers aircraft structure, aerodynamics, jet engines, flight mechanics, and aviation maintenance practices.

C35.name: Common Engineering Programme
C35.description: A foundational first-year program allowing students to explore various engineering disciplines before choosing a specific diploma.
careers: Exploratory Engineering Track (leads to all SEG Diplomas)
modules_yr2: Specialization selection takes place in Year 1 Semester 2

C36.name: Diploma in Computer Engineering
C36.description: Combines software engineering with hardware systems, microcontrollers, IoT devices, and cyber-physical security.

C42.name: Diploma in Engineering with Business
C42.description: Blends technical engineering competencies with business management, techno-entrepreneurship, and product innovation.

C52.name: Diploma in Aerospace Systems & Management
C52.description: Focuses on aerospace electronics (avionics), air traffic management, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), and airport operations.

C62.name: Diploma in Biomedical Engineering
C62.description: Integrates engineering principles with medical sciences to develop healthcare electronics, medical devices, and bio-instrumentation.

C85.name: Diploma in Advanced & Digital Manufacturing
C85.description: Focuses on Industry 4.0 smart factory solutions, 3D printing/additive manufacturing, digital twin simulation, and industrial automation.

C87.name: Diploma in Robotics & Mechatronics
C87.description: Integrates mechanical engineering, electronics, autonomous systems, sensors, and programmable logic controllers (PLCs).
